name: galley-editor
description: galley's edit-mode browser bundle. DEV-TIME ONLY: the built output lives in internal/serve/assets and is committed; `just assets` rebuilds it. Nothing at runtime needs node.

scripts.kit-copy: go mod download github.com/subaud-tools/tools-common && KIT_DIR=$(go list -m -f '{{.Dir}}' github.com/subaud-tools/tools-common) && test -n "$KIT_DIR" && mkdir -p kit && cp -f "$KIT_DIR/localweb/page/assets/share.js" "$KIT_DIR/localweb/page/assets/share.css" "$KIT_DIR/localweb/page/assets/enter.js" "$KIT_DIR/localweb/page/assets/dom.js" "$KIT_DIR/localweb/page/assets/selection.js" "$KIT_DIR/localweb/page/assets/msgstate.js" "$KIT_DIR/localweb/page/assets/tip.js" kit/ && sed -n '/^\/\/ ---- share.js/,$p' "$KIT_DIR/localweb/page/assets/kit.d.ts" > kit/share.d.ts && awk '/^\/\/ ---- /{p=/^\/\/ ---- enter\.js/} p' "$KIT_DIR/localweb/page/assets/kit.d.ts" > kit/enter.d.ts && test -s kit/enter.d.ts && awk '/^\/\/ ---- /{p=/^\/\/ ---- dom\.js/} p' "$KIT_DIR/localweb/page/assets/kit.d.ts" > kit/dom.d.ts && test -s kit/dom.d.ts && awk '/^\/\/ ---- /{p=/^\/\/ ---- msgstate\.js/} p' "$KIT_DIR/localweb/page/assets/kit.d.ts" > kit/msgstate.d.ts && test -s kit/msgstate.d.ts && awk '/^\/\/ ---- /{p=/^\/\/ ---- tip\.js/} p' "$KIT_DIR/localweb/page/assets/kit.d.ts" > kit/tip.d.ts && test -s kit/tip.d.ts && sed -n '/^\.kit-pill /,/no_reply/p' "$KIT_DIR/localweb/page/assets/kit.css" > kit/msgpill.css && grep -q no_reply kit/msgpill.css && cp -f "$KIT_DIR/localweb/page/assets/kit.d.ts" kit/kit.d.ts && chmod 644 kit/kit.d.ts kit/share.js kit/share.css kit/share.d.ts kit/enter.js kit/enter.d.ts kit/dom.js kit/selection.js kit/msgstate.js kit/dom.d.ts kit/msgstate.d.ts kit/msgpill.css kit/tip.js kit/tip.d.ts
scripts.build-copy: go mod download github.com/subaud-tools/tools-common && KIT_DIR=$(go list -m -f '{{.Dir}}' github.com/subaud-tools/tools-common) && test -n "$KIT_DIR" && mkdir -p build && cp -f "$KIT_DIR/localweb/page/build/eslint.base.mjs" "$KIT_DIR/localweb/page/build/probe.mjs" build/ && cp -f "$KIT_DIR/localweb/page/build/mermaid-entry.ts" mermaid-entry.ts && chmod 644 build/eslint.base.mjs build/probe.mjs mermaid-entry.ts
scripts.build: npm run --silent kit-copy && npm run --silent build-copy && npm run --silent build:editor-js && npm run --silent build:editor-css && npm run --silent build:front-js && npm run --silent build:front-css && npm run --silent build:mermaid && npm run --silent probe
